correctness.rationale: The stable partition is equitable. Two same-color lifts in a universal cover admit a rooted isomorphism: match neighbors by color, and after the first level omit one parent of the same paired color on each side. Iterate on the tree of lifts. For a tree the cover is the finite tree itself. In the unicyclic case, the vertices whose removal leaves two infinite components are exactly the spine, so the rooted isomorphism translates or reflects the spine, inducing a well-defined cycle symmetry modulo its length. The induced decoration maps need not themselves be periodic: choose one rooted isomorphism per cycle residue, taking the specific lifted map at the residue of the first vertex. This yields a finite-graph automorphism carrying it to the second. Every automorphism preserves refinement colors. In the eight-vertex witness the degree-three vertices have three degree-two neighbors and every degree-two vertex sees one neighbor of each degree. The degree partition is equitable, but the four degree-two triangle vertices cannot be permuted to the two connector vertices; triangle interchanges and end-for-end reversal give the claimed orbits. C3 disjoint union C4 checks the disconnected limitation. The embedded atlas test is optional corroboration, not the basis of the all-order conclusion; its code was inspected, not run.
